annotations.text:
One concept, built to your spec.

Header is the working bar from transactions.module.css — name at control scale, counts on the segments, totals in the divided strip at the foot. No 38px H1, no floating counters.

Row order: target first, then who's asking, then terms, then actions.

Switch light and dark in each artboard's tweak row.

THE ROW.

Column one leads with the player or the role, because a transfer starts with who somebody wants. The position badge sits on the sentence's baseline the way .posMark does on Transactions, not in a flex row.

Actions are flex and right-aligned, so a row with one button shows one button and a Board row shows nothing. No reserved voids.

Green in the subline marks what's yours: "On your squad", "You have M. Kerkez".

THE LIVE MATCH.

Saliba, in Your Targets. Border in --color-border-accent over --color-tint-accent, lifted off the hairline list, with a red dot and the standing bid and clock in mono — the only two numbers on this page that move while you look at them.

Primary action swaps to Bid in Auction.

Tint alone would vanish for anyone who can't separate it from the ground, so it carries a border and a dot as well.

ADD A TARGET.

520px ResponsiveModal, shadow and no border. Kind toggle, player search with a preview, then the audience ladder in order of exposure — each rung says what happens rather than "public" or "private".

Under 640px the same dialog becomes the bottom drawer beside it: rounded top only, 92dvh, safe-area foot, 44px controls.

390px.

Three lines per row: name and money, club and stance, then the actions at 44px. The four columns go to two, and the terms column uses display:contents so the money and the stance split to different lines instead of staying glued together.
